report_name: Urban One Finalizes $675,000 Settlement for 2025 Data Breach

identities.name: Urban One, Inc.
identities.description: A media company that discovered a data breach in March 2025 compromising the personally identifiable information (PII) of approximately 13,778 employees. The company finalized a $675,000 settlement to resolve the resulting class-action lawsuit.

identities.name: Gomian Konneh
identities.description: The lead plaintiff in the class-action lawsuit, Gomian Konneh v. Urban One, Inc., filed after the 2025 data breach.

identities.name: CyEx
identities.description: The company providing three years of three-bureau credit monitoring and identity theft protection services as part of the settlement for the Urban One data breach.

identities.name: Urban One Employees
identities.description: A class of approximately 13,778 current and former employees of Urban One whose sensitive personal and financial information was compromised in the March 2025 data breach.
